items.text: U-Adamu, uSeti, u-Enoshe,
uKhenani, uMahalaleli, uJarede,
u-Enoke, uMethusela, uLameka,
UNowa, uShemi, uHamu noJafete.
Amadodana kaJafete ngu uGomere, noMagogi, noMadayi, noYavan, noTubhali, noMeshegi, noTirasi.
Amadodana kaGomere; I-Ashikenazi noRifati noTogarma.
Amadodana kaJavani ngu u-Elisha noTharishishi, amaKitimi namaDodani.
Amadodana kaHamu: IKushe neMisraimi, iPhuthi neKhanani.
Amadodana kaKushe: uSeba, noHavila, noSabheta, noRama, noSabhetega. Amadodana kaRama ngu uSheba noDedani.
UKushe wazala uNimrodi; waqala ukuba namandla emhlabeni.
UMisirayimi wazala amaLudi, nama-Anami, namaLehabi, namaNafetuhi;
namaPatrusi, namaKasluhi, okwaphuma kuwo amaFilisti, namaKafitori.
UKhanani wazala uSidoni, izibulo lakhe, noHeti,
namaJebusi, nama-Amori, namaGirigashi,
namaHivi, nama-Arki, namaSini,
nama-Arvadi namaZemari namaHamati.
Amadodana kaShemi: I-Elamu, ne-Ashuri, no-Arpakisadi, noLudi, no-Aramu, no-Use, noHule, noGeteri, noMesheki.
UArpakishadi wazala uShela, uShela wazala uHebhere.
UHebhere wazalelwa amadodana amabili: igama lomunye lalinguPhelege; ngokuba emihleni yakhe izwe ladatshulwa, igama lomfowabo lalinguJokitani.
UJokithani wazala o-Alemodadi, noSelefi, noHasaremaweti, noJeraki;
noHadoramu, no-Uzali, noDikila,
no-Ebali, no-Abimayeli, noSheba,
no-Ofiri noHavila noJobabi. Bonke babengamadodana kaJokithani.
UShemi, u-Arpakishade, uShela,
u-Ebere, uPelege, uRehu,
uSerugi, noNahori, noThera,
U-Abrama; nguyena u-Abrahama.
Amadodana ka-Abrahama: u-Isaka no-Ishmayeli.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zabo: Izibulo lika-Ishmayeli nguNebhayoti; kwase kuba iKedari, ne-Adibeyeli, neMibisamu,
uMishima noDuma, iMasa, uHadadi noThema,
noJethuri, noNafisi, noKedema. Lawa angamadodana ka-Ishmayeli.
Amadodana kaKetura, isancinza sika-Abrahama: wazala uZimran, noJokishani, noMedani, noMidiyani, no-Ishibhaki, noShuwagi. Amadodana kaJokishani ngu uSheba noDedani.
Amadodana kaMidiyani ngu u-Efa no-Eferi no-Enoke no-Abida no-Elidaha. Bonke bangamadodana kaKetura.
U-Abrahama wazala u-Isaka; Amadodana ka-Isaka; u-Esawu no-Israyeli.
Amadodana ka-Esawu: o-Elifazi, noRehuweli, noJewusi, noJalamu, noKora.
Amadodana ka-Elifazi; uThemani, no-Omari, noZefi, noGathamu, noKenazi, noThimna, no-Amaleki.
Amadodana kaRehuweli; noNahati, noSeraki, noShama, noMisa.
Amadodana kaSeyiri: uLothani, noShobhali, noSibeyoni, no-Ana, noDishoni, no-Eseri, noDishani.
Amadodana kaLothani: uHori noHomamu, uThimna wayengudadewabo kaLothani.
Amadodana kaShobali; u-Alian, noManahati, no-Ebali, noSefi, no-Onam. Amadodana kaSibeyoni: ngoSibeyoni; U-Aya, no-Ana.
Amadodana ka-Ana: Dishon. Amadodana kaDishoni; u-Amramu no-Esbani noJitran noKerani.
Amadodana ka-Ezeri: UBilhan noZavan noJakan. Amadodana kaDisani; U-Uze no-Aran.
Lawa angamakhosi abusa ezweni lakwa-Edomi, kungakabusi nkosi phezu kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; uBhela indodana kaBeyori, igama lomuzi wakhe laliyiDinihaba.
Wafa uBhela, wathi uYobhabhi, unyana kaSeraki, waseBhotsera, walawula esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uJobabhi, uHusham, wasezweni lamaTeman, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uHusam; uHadadi, unyana kaBhedadi, owanqoba amaMidiyani emhlabeni wakwaMowabhi, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe; igama lomuzi wakhe laliyi-Awiti.
Wafa uHadadi; uSamla waseMasereka waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uSamla; uSawule, waseRehobhoti yoMlambo, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uSawule; uBhahali-hanan, unyana ka-Akebhore, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Wafa uBhahali-hanan; uHadadi waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe; igama lomuzi wakhe laliyiPhayi; igama lomkakhe lalinguMehetabheli, indodakazi kaMatredi, indodakazi kaMeshahabi.
UHadadi naye wafa. Izikhulu zakwa-Edomi zazingo; induna uThimna, induna u-Aliya, induna uJetethi,
induna u-Aholibama, induna u-Ela, induna uPinoni,
induna uKenazi, induna uThemani, induna uMibhizari,
UMbusi uMagdiel, uMbusi u-Iram. Lezi yizikhulu zakwa-Edomi.
